```{r header, echo = FALSE}
# Header
div(
  class = "custom-header",
  
  # Logo
  tags$img(
    src = 'misc/images/MTA_NYC_logo.svg',
    class = "custom-header-logo",
    alt = "MTA logo"
  ),
  
  # Title + Subtitle + Author
  div(
    class = "custom-header-text",
    tags$h1("Permanent Art Catalog"),
    tags$h3("A visual exploration of subway art across New York City"),
    tags$h4("Last updated: July 22, 2025")
  )
)
```

```{r first_dropdown, context="sidebar", echo = FALSE}
# First dropdown 
selectInput("agency", "Transportation Authority",
            choices = sort(unique(df$agency)),
            selected = "NYCT"
)

```

```{r second_dropdown, context="sidebar", echo = FALSE}
# Second dropdown
renderUI({
  req(input$agency)

  filtered_services <- df |> 
    filter(agency == input$agency) |> 
    pull(station_name) |> 
    unique() |> 
    sort()

  selectInput(
    "station_name",
    "Station Name",
    choices = filtered_services,
    selected = "Fulton Center"
  )
})

```

```{r results, context="server", echo = FALSE}
# Display Artwork and Metadata
renderUI({
  req(input$agency, input$station_name)

  row <- df |> 
    filter(agency == input$agency, station_name == input$station_name) |> 
    slice(1)

  img_urls <- strsplit(row$art_img_direct, ";")[[1]]

  div(
    class = "art-info-box",
    tagList(
      # Image gallery
      tags$div(class = "lightbox-gallery",
        lapply(img_urls, function(img_url) {
          tags$a(href = img_url, target = "_blank",
            tags$img(
              src = img_url,
              class = "hover-img art-image",
              onerror = "this.onerror=null;this.src='www/logo.png';"
            )
          )
        })
      ),

      # Art metadata
      tags$h3(class = "art-title", row$art_title),
      tags$p(class = "art-meta", tags$strong("Artist:"), tags$br(), row$artist),
      tags$p(class = "art-meta", tags$strong("Date:"), tags$br(), row$art_date),
      tags$p(class = "art-meta", tags$strong("Materials:"), tags$br(), row$art_material),
      tags$p(class = "art-meta", tags$strong("Serving Lines:"), tags$br(), row$line),
      tags$p(tags$strong("Description:"), tags$br(), row$art_description)
    )
  )
})

```
